extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve used for?
faqs.a: A size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve sits in the float sub or bit sub above the bit and stops drilling fluid and cuttings flowing back up the string when circulation stops, when connections are made, and in a kick. The smallest float valve in the range is a flapper valve for 3-1/2″ API Reg and 2-7/8″ API IF float subs.

faqs.q: Which sub connections does the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve fit?
faqs.a: The size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve fits float or bit subs cut with 3-1/2″ API Reg and 2-7/8″ API IF (box × pin) connections. Check the sub connection and the recess dimensions before ordering: valve OD 2-13/32 in, sub recess 2-7/16 in, baffle plate recess 1-29/32 in, length 6-1/2 in.

faqs.q: What are the dimensions of the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve?
faqs.a: The size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve has valve OD 2-13/32 in, sub recess 2-7/16 in, baffle plate recess 1-29/32 in, length 6-1/2 in and Model G 1-1/4 in bore. The recess in the sub is the valve outside diameter plus 1/32 in. Send the sub drawing on the RFQ if the recess is not standard.

faqs.q: What pressure is the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve rated for?
faqs.a: The listing gives 7,500 psi working pressure for the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve, which is Forum's rating for its Model F and G valves. We confirm the rating of other makes on the quotation, so state the make and the differential pressure you expect.

faqs.q: What models does the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve come in?
faqs.a: The listing gives Model G (flapper) and Model GA (flapper, ported). Plunger valves have a spring-loaded plunger for positive shut-off, while flapper valves swing fully clear for an unrestricted bore. Ported models allow partial fill-up and pressure readings.

faqs.q: Which makes are listed for the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve?
faqs.a: The size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve is listed from Crestex, Baker, Forum and Drillmax, with part or cage numbers 152-432, 14423100N and 1520433. Baker-pattern valves of the same size and model interchange in the same sub, and we confirm the match against your sub connection on the quotation.

faqs.q: What documents come with the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve?
faqs.a: We supply the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve new to the size, model and make on your RFQ, and can quote the float sub and repair parts with it. The listing gives no product standard, so ask for the material certificate and dimensional report you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What else do I order with the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve?
faqs.a: Order the 3-1/2″ API Reg and 2-7/8″ API IF (box × pin) float sub or bit sub that holds the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve, and spare flappers or plungers for repair. See [float valves](/c/oilfield-float-valves) and the guide on [oilfield check valves](/blog/oilfield-check-valves-explained) for how drill pipe float valves fit the string.

faqs.q: How should the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve be run in the string?
faqs.a: If more than one size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve runs in the same string, space them apart. Choose a ported model when you need to read shut-in drill pipe pressure or want the string to fill partly while running in.

faqs.q: How does the size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve differ from the size 3-1/2 IF valve?
faqs.a: The size 2F-3R drill pipe float valve fits 3-1/2″ API Reg and 2-7/8″ API IF (box × pin) subs, while the [size 3-1/2 IF valve](/p/drill-pipe-float-valve-size-3-1-2-if) fits a different connection and has a different valve outside diameter. faqs.a: The size 6F drill pipe float valve fits 8-5/8″ API Reg, 6-5/8″ API FH and 6-5/8″ API IF subs, while the [size 5F-6R valve](/p/drill-pipe-float-valve-size-5f-6r) fits a different connection and has a different valve outside diameter. Choose the size from the sub connection, then the model.

faqs.q: Where is the size 6F drill pipe float valve used?
faqs.a: The size 6F drill pipe float valve is used in the drill string just above the bit, in drilling and well-control work where backflow through the string must be stopped. See [float valves](/c/oilfield-float-valves).

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the size 6F drill pipe float valve?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the size 6F drill pipe float valve as ex-stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the size, model and sub connection through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
